He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.
“Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Amnon
people.line: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom

people.name: Tamar
people.line: David's daughter, raped by her half-brother Amnon

translations.web: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
translations.bsb: And Absalom never said a word to Amnon, either good or bad, because he hated Amnon for violating his sister Tamar.
translations.kjv: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
translations.asv: And Absalom spake unto Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
